payload_json: {"agentId":"lead","prompt":"You are one QA hunter-pack leg reviewing the checkout at its current HEAD (the merged commit under review). Work findings-only: do NOT edit any file, do NOT commit, do NOT touch git remotes — leave the tree exactly as the dispatch filled it (a later phase asserts the tree is clean). Hunt for defects in this commit's OWN surface: build the bounded review set with ONE command: `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD -- src/qa scripts/qa tests/qa` (typically a handful of files — the story's own surface; if it is empty, say so and finish with an empty findings array). Review ONLY the files in that list — do NOT grep or read beyond them (the team's budget is deliberately small). Your ASSIGNED lens is in `.qds/run-context.json` under the `instructions` key (reads like 'Hunter-pack lens \"correctness\" over <repo> @ <sha>; findings only'): read that field FIRST and review the files strictly under the lens discipline it names — correctness (logic errors, broken invariants, error-handling gaps, race/edge conditions), secret hygiene (any key, token, credential, or secret-shaped literal introduced or left exposed, including in tests and fixtures), or diff scope (changes outside the commit's stated purpose, unexplained included files, scope creep). If the field is missing, review under all three disciplines and note the absence in your summary. Be thorough but bounded: report only findings you are confident are real. When you finish, the team finish with EXACTLY one JSON object of shape {\"findings\": [{\"finding_text\": \"<one-sentence finding>\", \"diff_context_ref\": \"<path[:line] or symbol the finding concerns>\"}], \"changedFiles\": []} as the final output — the write-capable teammate MUST include the mandatory changedFiles field (an empty array: findings-only work changes nothing) — an empty findings array is a valid result when the diff is clean. No other trailing text after the JSON.","model":"openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5"}
